judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a draft spec, a definition-of-done file, and a single acceptance test in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`, without making any implementation changes to `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or adding `ajv` to `package.json`. Because `ToolRegistry.execute` remains unmodified, the newly added test fails immediately by invoking the executor and returning `'forecast'` instead of a validation error. Furthermore, the candidate omitted almost all acceptance criteria from the ticket, including schema compilation at registration, dynamic schema caching, privacy guarantees on error messages/logs, orchestrator retry-loop testing, and updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md`.
